;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Sanctions against Iran]]
**[[Royal Marines]] seize control of an [[oil tanker]] off the coast of [[Gibraltar]] that was en route to [[Baniyas]] in [[Syria]], suspected of breaching [[European Union|EU]] sanctions against Syria, carrying [[Iran]]ian crude oil. The [[United Kingdom|United Kingdom's]] Ambassador to Iran, [[Robert Macaire (diplomat)|Robert Macaire]], is summoned in [[Tehran]] over the incident, which Iran describes as an "illegal seizure". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-48865030 (BBC News)]

;Art and culture
*[[2019 Salute to America|Salute to America]]
**A major holiday celebration and [[military parade]] is held in [[Washington, D.C.]], [[United States]], by [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] to commemorate [[Independence Day (United States)|the Fourth of July/Independence Day]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/07/04/politics/salute-to-america-july-4th-event/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/trump-delivers-remarks-military-style-salute-america-event-n1026656 (NBC)]

;Business and economics
*[[Lightsource BP]], a [[solar energy]] developer headquartered in [[London]], has announced that it will acquire utility-scale solar projects in [[Brazil]], 1.9 gigawatts of projects, for an undisclosed sum. This is a major expansion for Lightsource, which is 43% owned by the energy giant [[BP]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lightsourcebp-m-a-brazil/lightsource-bp-makes-major-brazil-solar-acquisition-idUSKCN1TZ1A3 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Ridgecrest earthquakes]]
**An earthquake with a magnitude of 6.4 with scores of [[foreshock]]s and [[aftershock]]s hits [[Southern California]], 150 miles (240 km) north of [[Los Angeles]] near the city of [[Ridgecrest, California|Ridgecrest]]. No injuries are reported. The earthquake is the largest in Southern California since the [[1999 Hector Mine earthquake]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/07/04/us/southern-california-earthquake/index.html (CNN)] [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/ci38443183/executive (USGS)] [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/ci38443191/executive (USGS)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**More than 80 people are missing after a migrant boat capsizes off the coast of [[Tunisia]], according to the [[International Organization for Migration]] (IOM). [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/jul/04/boat-with-dozens-of-migrants-capsizes-off-tunisia-coast (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[Australia–North Korea relations]]
**An [[Australia]]n student who had been detained in [[North Korea]] on June 25 is freed thanks to diplomatic talks between Australia and North Korea via [[Sweden|Swedish]] officials. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-northkorea-student/australian-student-released-from-north-korea-says-hes-very-good-idUSKCN1TZ09L (Reuters)]
*[[Kosovo–Serbia relations]]
**Amid a deterioration in relations, [[Kosovo]] bans all [[Serbia]]n officials from entering the country, in response to "constant propaganda and [[Fake news|false news]] about the country and our citizens" from [[Belgrade]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/kosovo-bans-serbian-officials-in-new-diplomatic-dispute/30037050.html (RFERL)]
